headline: Dum Dum
caption:
Alex Pereira says nobody cares about Josh Hokit's title fight, and Hokit is firing back 🔥
Pereira or Hokit? 👇

Pereira asked why Kayla Harrison vs. Amanda Nunes isn't headlining UFC 334 over Ciryl Gane vs. Hokit. Hokit answered that Pereira lost his aura and hopes Sergei Pavlovich finishes him at UFC 335. UFC news.

Who wins this war of words?
question: Pereira or Hokit?

v2.story: Pereira says nobody's watching Hokit's title fight. Hokit says Pereira lost his aura.
